description: For a traveller who already bought a Slashtel eSIM: returns data used, data left, plan size, expiry, status (not yet installed, active, used up or expired) and whether automatic top-up (Keep me connected) is on. Needs the email used at checkout AND the eSIM's ICCID (the long number starting 89, shown in the order email and in phone settings under the eSIM). Both must match the same order. Use it when someone asks how much data they have left or why their eSIM stopped working.

email.description: Email address used to buy the eSIM

iccid.description: The eSIM's ICCID, 18 to 22 digits, usually starting 89

name: check_esim_status
title: Check eSIM status
